com_config_endpoint_name_exists: An endpoint with this name already exists
com_config_endpoint_name_reserved: This name belongs to a built-in LibreChat endpoint; choose another name
com_config_server_name_exists: A server with this name already exists
com_config_server_name_no_dots: Server name cannot contain dots or start with $
com_config_mcp_invalid_after_edit: Cannot save: MCP server "{{entry}}" is missing required field "{{field}}" for its transport type.
com_config_mcp_process_locked: This server runs a local process defined in librechat.yaml. Its command, arguments, environment, working directory and error output can only be changed there.
com_config_reset_confirm: Reset "{{field}}" to its default value? This removes the DB override.
com_config_reset_base_dirty: Save or discard your changes before resetting
com_config_values_revert_inherited_aria: Remove the {{scope}} override of {{name}}; it inherits {{value}} from Base
com_config_values_ignored_override_desc: An admin override is stored for this setting, but LibreChat reads it only from librechat.yaml. Remove the override to clean it up.
com_config_values_shadowed_block: Ignored: while the Global (all providers) section exists, LibreChat reads title settings only from it. Global {{field}}: {{value}}
com_config_values_shadowed_field: Ignored: Global (all providers) sets {{field}} to {{value}}, which takes precedence
com_config_simplify_disabled: Remove extra locale entries before switching to simple mode
com_config_nothing_stored_one: Nothing was stored: {{count}} change was skipped
com_config_nothing_stored_other: Nothing was stored: {{count}} changes were skipped
com_config_nothing_to_save: Nothing to save: blank items and unchanged values are ignored
com_config_review_base_affects: Applies to every user, unless a role, group or user profile overrides it.
com_config_review_drift: Changed since you loaded it; now {{value}}
com_config_review_import_base_desc: Applies to every user. Merged into the base admin overrides; settings the YAML doesn't mention stay as they are.
com_config_review_import_create: Create a new role or group
com_config_review_import_create_desc: Also creates the role or group itself, with no members, and a profile for it
com_config_review_import_desc: Upload or paste librechat.yaml settings, a whole file or just a snippet. You'll choose where they go and review every change before anything is saved. librechat.yaml itself is never modified.
com_config_review_import_existing_desc: Merged into that profile's overrides. A profile is created if it doesn't have one yet.
com_config_review_import_hide_unchanged: Hide settings that are already set
com_config_review_import_show_unchanged_: Show {{count}} setting that is already set
Show {{count}} settings that are already set
com_config_review_import_skip_process: process-backed (stdio) MCP servers can only be defined in librechat.yaml
com_config_review_import_skip_unsafe: keys containing '.' or starting with '$' can't be saved through the admin API yet; set this in librechat.yaml
com_config_review_import_skip_hidden_sec: LibreChat hides the librechat.yaml key here, so the import cannot tell whether this one differs; replace it in the endpoint card
com_config_review_import_summary_one: {{count}} setting selected for {{target}}. Clear a checkbox to leave a setting out.
com_config_review_import_summary_other: {{count}} settings selected for {{target}}. Clear a checkbox to leave a setting out.
com_config_review_import_unchanged: Already set to this value, so it is not selected
com_config_review_import_unknown: Not recognised by this panel version; imported as-is
com_config_review_import_will_create: A profile will be created for {{name}} (priority {{priority}}).
com_config_review_issues_one: {{count}} problem must be fixed before saving
com_config_review_issues_other: {{count}} problems must be fixed before saving
com_config_review_import_issues_one: {{count}} problem must be fixed before importing: fix it in the YAML or leave that setting out
com_config_review_import_issues_other: {{count}} problems must be fixed before importing: fix them in the YAML or leave those settings out
com_config_review_none: No changes will be saved. Blank items and values that match the current configuration are ignored.
com_config_review_reset_body: Removes every base override saved in the admin panel. Each setting goes back to its librechat.yaml value, or LibreChat's default when the file doesn't set it. Role, group and user profiles are not changed. This can't be undone.
com_config_review_reset_title: Revert all admin overrides to librechat.yaml
com_config_skill_sync_banner: Changes here apply to syncs started from LibreChat. The scheduled sync (on startup and on its interval) reads librechat.yaml only.
com_config_list_owned: This list overrides librechat.yaml: changes to the list there won't apply until you revert it.
com_config_list_owned_scope: This profile has its own copy of this list, replacing the one from Base: changes to the Base list won't reach these users until you revert it.
com_config_global_titles_banner: The Global (all providers) section is set, so LibreChat reads title settings only from there. The title settings of this provider are ignored.
com_config_global_titles_endpoint_banner: The Global (all providers) section is set, so LibreChat reads title settings only from there. The title settings of this endpoint are ignored.
com_config_session_expired: Your session ended, so nothing was saved. Your unsaved changes are still here: sign in again, then save.
com_config_session_sign_in: Sign in again (opens a new tab)
com_config_review_scope_affects: Only {{type}} {{name}} is affected; everything else keeps inheriting from Base.
com_config_review_title_base_one: Save {{count}} change to the base configuration?
com_config_review_title_base_other: Save {{count}} changes to the base configuration?
com_config_review_warning_empty_allowlis: An empty list allows nothing. Remove the override instead to go back to the default.
com_config_review_warning_shadowed: Global (all providers) sets this and takes precedence, so this change has no effect while it does
com_config_review_warning_shadowed_block: While the Global (all providers) section exists, LibreChat reads title settings only from it, so this change has no effect
com_config_review_warning_ownership: This list will now be managed in the admin panel: changes to it in librechat.yaml won't apply until you revert it.
com_config_review_warning_ownership_scop: This list replaces the whole list these users inherit from Base.
com_config_skip_dedicated: saved through its own settings section, not the config API
com_config_skip_yaml_value: set by librechat.yaml or LibreChat defaults; it can't be cleared here
com_config_skip_not_stored: LibreChat did not store it; configure it in librechat.yaml
com_config_skip_not_applied: saved, but LibreChat still uses the librechat.yaml value
com_config_skip_yaml_merged: LibreChat merges this librechat.yaml value back in; it can't be removed here
com_config_apply_failed: Save failed and nothing was changed
com_config_apply_not_effective_one: Saved, but {{count}} change did not take effect
com_config_apply_not_effective_other: Saved, but {{count}} changes did not take effect
com_config_apply_rollback_incomplete: Save failed and could not be fully rolled back; reload to see what is stored
com_config_issue_blank_key: has a blank key: name it, or remove the entry
com_config_issue_blank_value: is blank: enter a value, or clear the field
com_config_issue_duplicate_merge_key: repeats a name another entry already uses
com_config_issue_entry_not_found: "{{name}}" no longer exists: it was removed or renamed since you loaded the page. Reload and try again.
com_config_issue_indexed_merge_key_write: must be saved as a whole list
com_config_issue_inherited_entry_immutab: "{{name}}" comes from the base configuration, so it can't be {{action}} in this profile
com_config_issue_invalid_email: must be a valid email address
com_config_issue_models_required: needs at least one model (LibreChat requires a default model list, even when it fetches models)
com_config_issue_process_mcp_field: can only be configured in librechat.yaml for process-backed MCP servers (command, args, env, cwd, stderr, stdio)
com_config_issue_secret_required_for_ren: Re-enter the API key to rename "{{name}}": its stored key can't be carried over to a new name
com_config_issue_union_dropped_key: isn't valid for this kind of value
com_config_issue_unsafe_key: has a key LibreChat can't store yet ("{{key}}" contains '.' or starts with '$'); set it in librechat.yaml
com_config_issue_yaml_entry_immutable: "{{name}}" is defined in librechat.yaml, so it can't be {{action}} here
com_config_issue_yaml_managed: is managed in librechat.yaml; LibreChat ignores admin overrides for it until it re-processes them
com_config_unsafe_key_error: Keys containing '.' or starting with '$' can't be saved through the admin API yet. Set this in librechat.yaml.
com_config_base_only_section: Configured in librechat.yaml only. LibreChat ignores admin overrides for this section, so it is read-only here and shows the current librechat.yaml values.
com_config_yaml_only_section: Read from librechat.yaml when LibreChat starts. Admin overrides have no effect, so this section is read-only here and shows the current librechat.yaml values.
com_config_read_only_empty: Nothing here is set in librechat.yaml, so LibreChat's defaults apply.
com_config_yaml_managed_field: Managed in librechat.yaml until LibreChat applies admin overrides for this setting. Shown read-only.
com_config_stale_override: A stored admin override for this setting has no effect.
com_config_stale_override_pending: The stale override will be removed when you save.
com_config_unknown_settings_desc: These settings come from a newer LibreChat than this admin panel supports. They are shown for reference and left unchanged when you save.
com_config_import_base_success_one: Imported {{count}} value into the base configuration
com_config_import_base_success_other: Imported {{count}} values into the base configuration
com_config_import_nothing: The YAML has no settings to import
com_config_import_as_current_desc: Merge the imported values into this profile's overrides
com_config_section_model_specs_desc: Preset models users pick from the model menu
com_config_section_mcp_servers_desc: Model Context Protocol servers that agents and chats can use
com_config_section_endpoints_desc: OpenAI-compatible providers, defined in librechat.yaml or added here.
com_config_section_transactions_desc: Record token usage per request (needed for balances)
com_config_desc_actions_allowedAddresses: Private network addresses (IP or host:port) agent actions may call. Other private addresses are blocked.
com_config_desc_actions_allowedDomains: Domains agent actions may call. Leave empty to allow any public domain.
com_config_desc_balance_autoRefillEnable: Add credits to balances on a schedule.
com_config_desc_balance_enabled: Track token usage against each user's credit balance. Users without credits can't send messages.
com_config_desc_balance_refillIntervalVa: Number of interval units between refills.
com_config_desc_balance_reservationTtlMs: How long credits held for a request in progress stay reserved before they are released.
com_config_desc_balance_startBalance: Credits a new user starts with.
com_config_desc_cloudfront_domain: CloudFront distribution domain that serves stored files.
com_config_desc_cloudfront_imageSigning: How access to images is signed: not at all, with cookies, or with signed URLs.
com_config_desc_cloudfront_invalidateOnD: Clear deleted files from the CloudFront cache. Needs a distribution ID.
com_config_desc_cloudfront_urlExpiry: How long a signed URL stays valid.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityCharLim: Characters of each tool input and output included when writing an activity label.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityEndpoin: Endpoint whose credentials run the activity label model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityLabel: Collapse each block of reasoning and tool calls under a short generated header.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityMaxPerR: Most activity labels written in one run (a cost cap).
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityModel: Model that writes activity labels. Defaults to the title model, then the conversation's model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityPhaseLa: Also write one summary for each phase of a run that has two or more activities.
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityPhaseMa: Most phase summaries written in one run (a cost cap).
com_config_desc_endpoint_activityPrompt: Replaces the instructions used to write activity labels.
com_config_desc_endpoint_headers: HTTP headers sent with every request to this provider. Values can use ${ENV_VAR} and {{LIBRECHAT_USER_*}} placeholders.
com_config_desc_endpoint_maxToolResultCh: Tool results longer than this many characters are truncated before the model sees them.
com_config_desc_endpoint_models_fetch: Fetch the model list from the provider's API. The default models are used if fetching fails.
com_config_desc_endpoint_models_userIdQu: Add the user's ID as a query parameter when fetching the model list.
com_config_desc_endpoint_reasoningLabel: Show a live one-line label that summarizes long model reasoning.
com_config_desc_endpoint_reasoningLabelM: Most reasoning-label requests made in one run (a cost cap).
Model that writes reasoning labels. Defaults to the activity model, then the title model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_streamRate: Milliseconds between streamed chunks shown to users. 0 turns smoothing off.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titleConvo: Generate a title for each new conversation.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titleEndpoint: Endpoint whose credentials run the title model, when it differs from the conversation's endpoint.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titleMethod: How the title is requested: a plain completion, a function call, or structured output.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titleModel: Model that writes titles. A fast, inexpensive model works best. Defaults to the conversation's model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titlePrompt: Replaces the instructions sent to the title model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titlePromptTemp: Template for the conversation text sent to the title model.
com_config_desc_endpoint_titleTiming: When to write the title: as soon as the first message is sent, or after the full response.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_allowed: Providers agents can use. Leave empty to allow all.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_capabil: Features agents can use. Capabilities left out are unavailable to every agent.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_disable: Hide the agent builder, so users can't create or edit agents.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_maxCita: Most file-search citations in one response.
Most citations taken from a single file.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_maxProv: Provider error messages are cut to this many characters before they are shown.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_maxRecu: Highest step limit an agent can be configured with.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_maxSuba: Most subagents one agent can call.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_minRele: File-search results scoring below this relevance (0–1) are left out.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_modelRe: How long a streaming model response may stay silent before it is aborted.
How long to wait for the model provider to start responding.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_recursi: Default maximum number of steps (model and tool calls) an agent takes in one run.
com_config_desc_endpoints_agents_toolApp: Ask users to approve tool calls before agents run them.
Default approval behavior: ask for each tool, don't ask, or skip approvals entirely.
com_config_desc_endpoints_allowedAddress: Private network addresses (IP or host:port) AI providers may be reached on. Other private addresses are blocked.
com_config_desc_endpoints_assistants_pol: How often to check the status of an assistant run.
com_config_desc_endpoints_assistants_pri: Users only see the assistants they created.
com_config_desc_endpoints_assistants_sup: Only these assistant IDs are listed.
com_config_desc_endpoints_assistants_tim: Longest time to wait for an assistant run to finish.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_addPara: Parameters added to every request, such as temperature or provider-specific options.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_apiKey: API key for this endpoint. Use ${ENV_VAR} to read it from the server environment, or user_provided to let each user enter their own.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_baseURL: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, for example https://api.example.com/v1.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_customP: Built-in endpoint whose parameters, and parameter controls, this endpoint uses (for example anthropic or google).
Parameters users can adjust for this endpoint, with their type, range and default.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_dropPar: Parameters removed from every request, for APIs that reject them (for example stop or user).
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_iconURL: Icon for the endpoint: an image URL or the name of a known provider.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_modelDi: Name shown on responses from this endpoint's models.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_name: Unique name shown in the model menu and used to refer to this endpoint.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_provide: Send requests with LibreChat's native Anthropic client instead of the OpenAI-compatible one.
com_config_desc_endpoints_custom_tokenCo: Token prices and context window sizes per model, used for balance accounting and context limits.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_avatarSizeLim: Largest profile picture users can upload.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_clientImageRe: Resize images in the browser before uploading them.
Images taller than this are scaled down.
Images wider than this are scaled down.
Compression quality of resized images, from 0 to 1.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_endpoints_dis: Turn off file uploads for this endpoint.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_endpoints_sup: File types allowed, as regular expressions such as image/.*. An empty list blocks every upload.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_endpoints_tot: Largest combined size of one upload.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_fileTokenLimi: Most tokens of a file's text added to a prompt.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_ocr_supported: File types sent to OCR to extract their text.
com_config_desc_fileConfig_text_supporte: File types whose text is extracted and added to the prompt.
com_config_desc_fileStrategies_default: Storage for files that have no more specific setting.
com_config_desc_fileStrategy: Where uploaded files are stored. Files already uploaded stay where they are.
com_config_desc_imageOutputType: Format of generated and processed images.
com_config_desc_includedTools: Only these tools are available. Leave empty to allow every tool.
com_config_desc_interface_autoSubmitFrom: Send a prompt passed in the page URL automatically.
com_config_desc_interface_codeHighlightT: Time between syntax-highlighting passes while code streams. Higher values use less CPU.
com_config_desc_interface_contextCost: Show the estimated cost of a conversation's context.
com_config_desc_interface_contextUsage: Show how much of the model's context window a conversation uses.
com_config_desc_interface_customWelcome: Greeting shown on the landing page. {{user.name}} is replaced with the user's name.
com_config_desc_interface_defaultPinnedT: Tools pinned to the prompt bar by default.
com_config_desc_interface_fileSearch: Let users search their uploaded files in chats.
com_config_desc_interface_generalChatRet: How long regular chats are kept when Retention mode is All.
com_config_desc_interface_mcpServers_pla: Placeholder text of the MCP server menu.
com_config_desc_interface_multiConvo: Let users compare responses from two models side by side.
com_config_desc_interface_parameters: Let users change model parameters such as temperature.
com_config_desc_interface_presets: Let users save and apply presets.
com_config_desc_interface_retentionMode: Which chats are deleted after their retention period: only temporary chats, or all chats.
com_config_desc_interface_runCode: Let users run code from code blocks.
com_config_desc_interface_schedules: Let users schedule prompts to run automatically.
com_config_desc_interface_sharedLinks: Let users share conversations through public links.
com_config_desc_interface_temporaryChat: Let users start temporary chats that are deleted automatically.
com_config_desc_interface_temporaryChatR: How long temporary chats are kept.
com_config_desc_interface_termsOfService: Link to your terms of service.
Users must accept the terms in a dialog before using LibreChat.
Terms shown in the acceptance dialog, in Markdown.
com_config_desc_interface_webSearch: Let users turn on web search in chats.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_apiKey: API key sent to the server, set here or entered by each user.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_chatMenu: Offer this server in the chat's MCP menu. Agents and model specs can still use it when off.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_command: Command that starts the server process.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_customUserVar: Values each user enters, such as a personal API key, available to headers and URLs as {{NAME}}.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_env: Environment variables of the server process.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_headers: HTTP headers sent with every request. Values can use ${ENV_VAR} and {{LIBRECHAT_USER_*}} placeholders.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_iconPath: Icon URL or data URI shown for the server.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_initTimeout: Time limit for starting and connecting to the server.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_oauth: OAuth client settings. Leave empty to discover them from the server.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_requiresOAuth: Whether users must sign in with OAuth. Detected automatically when not set.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_serverInstruc: Instructions added to the model's prompt: none, the server's own instructions, or your own text.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_startup: Connect when LibreChat starts. Turn off for servers that need each user to sign in first.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_timeout: Time limit for each request to the server.
com_config_desc_mcpServers_type: How LibreChat connects: stdio (a local process), WebSocket, SSE or streamable HTTP.
com_config_desc_mcpSettings_allowedAddre: Private network addresses (IP or host:port) MCP servers may run on. Other private addresses are blocked.
com_config_desc_mcpSettings_allowedDomai: Domains MCP servers may be reached on. Leave empty to allow any public domain.
com_config_desc_memory_agent: Agent that saves memories: an existing agent, or a provider and model.
com_config_desc_memory_disabled: Turn the memory feature off for everyone.
com_config_desc_memory_messageWindowSize: How many recent messages the memory agent reads.
com_config_desc_memory_personalize: Let users turn memory on or off for themselves.
com_config_desc_memory_tokenLimit: Most tokens of memory kept for each user.
com_config_desc_memory_validKeys: Categories memories may be stored under. Leave empty to allow any.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_addedEndpoint: Endpoints shown in the model menu next to the specs.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_enforce: Only model specs can be used. Other endpoints and models are hidden from users.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_artifact: Turn on artifacts (rendered code, documents and diagrams), or choose an artifacts mode.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_askUserQ: Let the model ask the user clarifying questions during a run.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_conversa: Suggested prompts shown on the landing page while this spec is selected.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_default: Start new conversations with this spec.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_describe: Have the model say what it is about to do before it uses a tool: off, every tool, or only the tools listed.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_descript: Short text shown under the label.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_executeC: Turn on code execution for this spec.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_fileSear: Turn on file search for this spec.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_group: Group in the model menu. An endpoint name nests the spec under that endpoint; any other name creates a section.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_groupIco: Icon of the spec's group: an image URL or a provider name. Set it on one spec per group.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_hideBadg: Hide the tool badges under the chat input while this spec is selected.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_iconURL: Icon for the spec: an image URL or a provider name.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_label: Name shown in the model menu.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_mcpServe: MCP servers the spec can use.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_memory: Use memories in this spec's conversations.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_name: Unique identifier of the spec, used in links and the API.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_order: Position in the model menu. Lower numbers come first.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_preset: Endpoint, model and parameters that conversations with this spec start from.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_preset_e: Endpoint the spec uses: a built-in provider or a custom endpoint's name.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_runInBac: Let tools run in the background: off, every tool, or only the tools listed.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_showIcon: Show the spec's icon in the chat header.
Show the spec's icon in the model menu.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_showInMe: List the spec in the model menu. A hidden spec still works when it is chosen by name.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_showOnLa: Show the spec's label and description on the landing page instead of the greeting.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_skills: Skills the spec can use: none, all, or only the skills listed.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_softDefa: Start new conversations with this spec only for users who haven't chosen a model before.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_subagent: Let the spec hand work off to other agents.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_list_webSearc: Turn on web search for this spec.
com_config_desc_modelSpecs_prioritize: Use model specs ahead of other endpoints and presets when starting new chats.
com_config_desc_ocr_strategy: Service that extracts text from documents and images.
com_config_desc_rateLimits_fileUploads_i: Uploads allowed from one IP address in each window.
com_config_desc_rateLimits_fileUploads_u: Uploads allowed for each user in each window.
com_config_desc_registration_allowedDoma: Only email addresses from these domains can sign up.
com_config_desc_registration_oauthStateT: How long a social sign-in may take to return from the provider.
com_config_desc_registration_socialLogin: Social sign-in options shown on the login page, in this order.
com_config_desc_secureImageLinks: Require sign-in to open links to uploaded images.
com_config_desc_skillSync_github_enabled: Import skills from GitHub repositories on a schedule.
com_config_desc_summarization_enabled: Summarize older messages when a conversation nears the model's context limit.
com_config_desc_summarization_prompt: Replaces the instructions for writing a summary.
com_config_desc_summarization_provider: Provider of the model that writes summaries.
com_config_desc_summarization_reserveRat: Share of the context window (0–1) kept free for the summary and new messages.
com_config_desc_summarization_trigger: When to summarize: at a share of the context window, when few tokens remain, or after a number of messages.
com_config_desc_transactions_enabled: Record token usage. Balance tracking needs this.
com_config_desc_turnstile_siteKey: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. Setting it adds a CAPTCHA to sign-up and login.
com_config_desc_webSearch_allowedAddress: Private network addresses (IP or host:port) self-hosted search services may run on.
com_config_desc_webSearch_rerankerType: Service that reorders results by relevance, or none.
com_config_desc_webSearch_scraperProvide: Service that reads the pages search results link to.
com_config_desc_webSearch_tavilySearchOp: Include an AI-written answer: off, on, or a basic or advanced answer.
Include page content: off, on, or as Markdown or plain text.
Only return results from this period.
com_config_label_models_userIdQuery: Append user ID to model list request
com_config_field_maxToolCallArgBytesByTo: Max tool call argument bytes by tool
com_config_section_fileStrategies_desc: Storage per file type (avatars, images, documents), when it differs from the file strategy
com_config_section_cloudfront_desc: Serve files through an Amazon CloudFront distribution
com_config_section_messageFilter_desc: Filter or block patterns in user messages
com_config_section_filters_desc: Detect and block or audit PII in messages, prompts, files, and other content
com_config_section_langfuse_desc: Connect this tenant to a Langfuse project to export traces and feedback scores
com_config_langfuse_description: Export traces and feedback scores from all agents in this organization.
